name: 53044 · Kohler, WI
findings: ZIP 53044 (Kohler) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53044 (Kohler) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53044 (Kohler) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
